findings.issue: Error path references undefined `res` (`HTTP ${res.status}`), so every non-OK API response throws ReferenceError; the ApiError class at api.ts:4 is never thrown and is dead code.
findings.suggestion: Use `response.status`/`response.statusText`, throw ApiError, and add a unit test with a stubbed 404 fetch — it would have caught this.

findings.issue: The in-memory cache stores the rejected promise, so one transient API failure permanently poisons that URL for the process lifetime, even though the spec treats the API as live and changing.
findings.suggestion: Delete the cache entry on rejection (cache.set after a successful fetch, or .catch cleanup), and test the retry path.

findings.issue: No test script, runner, or test files; 781 lines of script logic (filtering, sorting, pagination, formatting) are guarded only by the out-of-tree acceptance suite.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (already a Vite project) and start with the pure units: format.ts helpers, buildMoveTables, pageUrl, idFromUrl/isSpeciesId.

findings.issue: `getAbilityPage(name).catch(() => null)` conflates 'not found' with 'upstream API error': a 500 renders the Not found page; getAbilityPage (data.ts:169) uses api() instead of tryApi, unlike every other lookup.
findings.suggestion: Use tryApi for the ability fetch and only 404 on genuine not-found; let real failures surface as 5xx.

findings.issue: Re-implements ID extraction and the <10000 species filter as an inline regex instead of reusing idFromUrl/isSpeciesId (api.ts:40-51); two copies that can drift.
findings.suggestion: Call the shared helpers and unit-test the type-filter path against alternate forms.

findings.issue: `Number(detail?.order ?? idFromUrl(ref.url) ?? 0)` yields NaN when a version-group detail fetch fails, making the comparator (data.ts:264) and the default-game choice (data.ts:266) unspecified.
findings.suggestion: Guard with Number.isFinite and fall back to 0; test with a mocked failing detail fetch.

findings.issue: Rows whose move-detail fetch failed are silently dropped from the tables, so a network hiccup shows fewer moves with no error or log.
findings.suggestion: Retry or log dropped moves; a test with one failed fetch should assert the visible behaviour.

findings.issue: Sorting correctness depends on data-sort-value attributes emitted in components.ts:117-124; a template refactor that renames them silently degrades every column to textContent comparison.
findings.suggestion: Extract the row comparison into a named testable function and assert it against missing values and both directions.

summary: The app ships zero tests of its own: no runner, no script, no files, despite a data layer full of pure, minutes-to-test functions. The gap has already let a real bug through — api.ts:22 references an undefined `res`, so every API error path throws ReferenceError (confirmed in the built bundle), and rejected fetches are cached forever. Any refactor of filtering, move-table construction, or client sorting is now completely unguarded once the acceptance suite is gone.
